The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7e90f88648f7bafc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume the Margulis–Platonov assertion for binary special groups over every finite separable extension of k. Fix the finite quotient S(k)/R, of exponent dividing e, and retain the degree-four data (D, ∗, S0) above. Let B be a nonempty finite set of places of k containing Bs and all places below the rank-zero places of the group SU(Cs, ∗) over S0. There are identity neighborhoods Wv in (U(Cs, ∗) ∩ S)(kv), for v ∈ B, such that every q ∈ (U(Cs, ∗) ∩ S)(k), qv ∈ Wv (v ∈ B), has trivial image in S(k)/R.
